review.brief: Review RM34-account-add-record-status (module: account, tier 1 of roadmap RM34, ticket MAG-33). Read the DIFF against main, not the whole module. Validate: (1) MODULE BOUNDARIES — internal/account imports no sibling module's internals; no HTML; no cross-module DB access. (2) DB-vs-DESIGN — the migration must match the design the USER confirmed at the design gate exactly: accounts.status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Inactive' CHECK (status IN ('Active','Inactive')) with NO backfill, and vehicles.status same type but DEFAULT 'Active'. The opposite defaults are DELIBERATE (D2/D3) — flagging them as an inconsistency is wrong; verify instead that they are what design.md says. Any divergence from the confirmed design is a BLOCKER finding. (3) D14 — the four account-status predicates must use EXISTS, not JOIN, and sqlc-generated struct shapes must be unchanged. (4) D4 — UpsertAccountFromOAuth must remain UNFILTERED; it is the auth path's deliberate exemption. Verify no status predicate crept in. (5) PERFORMANCE — per the declared read-heavy profile, confirm no new index was added and that the index plan in design.md is justified. (6) SPEC/TASK COVERAGE — every tasks.md item is ticked and backed by real code; specs match behaviour. (7) ANTI-GAMING — no acceptance criterion was weakened or deleted; no status was self-approved. (8) TEST QUALITY — judge by READING, never by running. Per D7 no new coverage was added; 9 existing tests were repaired via a shared activateAccount helper because they seeded under a never-activated account. Confirm that repair is legitimate (the gate genuinely hides those rows) and not a weakening of assertions. SIGNALS: go build, go vet, gofmt, make sqlc and openspec validate --strict were ASSISTANT-run and clean. The TEST SUITE was run and reported passing by the OWNER, not the assistant. Do not run the suite yourself.

decisions.decision: ADD COLUMN ... DEFAULT realizes both defaults with no explicit backfill UPDATE
decisions.why: Since PG11 a non-volatile DEFAULT fills existing rows without a rewrite, so vehicles get Active from the clause alone. Verified against Postgres docs, not assumed.

decisions.decision: UpdateAccountLanguage filters status=Active, so a language switch on an inactive account silently no-ops
decisions.why: Consistent with Step 2's blanket filter. Harmless: an inactive account cannot reach the language switch, since login is refused before a session exists.

decisions.decision: database design gate confirmed: DDL, defaults and the no-new-index plan approved as proposed
decisions.why: User replied 'continue' to the presented DDL, index plan and D9 consequence without requesting changes.

decisions.decision: one serial worker for T1-T6 instead of six per-wave dispatches
decisions.why: The tasks form a linear chain in one module over overlapping files (query.sql, sqlc regen, service.go). Six dispatches would re-read the doc pack six times.

decisions.decision: overrode the worker's self-reported 'done' to awaiting-user-verification on the 10 suite-dependent tasks
decisions.why: Contract: done requires the owner's reported suite pass. Build/vet/sqlc are not test execution. Only docs and leader-run signals are genuinely done.

decisions.decision: repaired two failing MAG-18 gateway charge tests on this branch instead of a separate one
decisions.why: Owner directed it after being told the mixing-of-concerns tradeoff. Both predate RM34 and fail on main; RM34 itself touches no gateway file.

decisions.decision: accepted the worker's repair of 9 tests beyond the dispatch's stated four-file scope
decisions.why: They seed vehicles/tokens under a never-activated account, so the D15 gate correctly hides them. Repair is required by D7, not new coverage.
